title: Badger Supports Alumni
description: We value all alumni from both our predecessor, Badger Support Network, and our current organization, Badger Supports.

blocks.title: Badger Supports Alumni
blocks.lead: Alumni of Badger Supports, Badger Support Network, and Badger SPILL remain part of our community. Former staff, volunteers, Student Supporters and leaders are welcome to stay connected.
body: Join our email list to receive Badger Supports updates. Stay in touch through an email address you plan to keep after graduation.

blocks.title: Alumni History
blocks.lead: Recognizing the people who helped build Badger Supports and Badger Support Network. Service periods retain the detail supported by the historical record.
